info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v5-spec
info.description: The Meeting Notes Retrieval API enables users to access detailed notes associated with various meetings. This endpoint allows consumers to efficiently retrieve the notes for specific meetings, ensuring that users have all necessary information readily available. Ideal for project managers, team leaders, and anyone involved in meeting follow-ups, this API streamlines the process of reviewing past discussions. By integrating this functionality, applications can enhance collaboration and keep teams informed with up-to-date meeting documentation.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve notes associated with meetings. Users can fetch all relevant notes to view the details discussed during meetings.

requestBody.description: A JSON object that represents the filter criteria for retrieving meeting notes. This request body should include any necessary parameters to specify which notes to retrieve based on the specified criteria.

ListMeetingsMeetingsNotesRequest.description: This schema represents the body of the request for obtaining meeting notes. It is expected to be a JSON formatted string.
